headline: **MLB Daily Recap: July 18, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox continued their winning streak with a 10-0 shutout victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, while the Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1 in a thrilling matchup. The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers 15-1, and the St. Louis Cardinals fell to the Chicago Cubs 3-5.

Injuries and availability have impacted several teams, with Chris Bassitt being transferred to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort, and JoJo Romero being placed on the 15-day injured list with an unspecified injury. Other notable injuries include Brent Rooker's bone bruise in his left knee, Brice Matthews' left knee sprain, and Brad Keller's right elbow UCL tear.

Several trades and roster movements have taken place, including the Baltimore Orioles acquiring Rudy Martin Jr. from the Kansas City Royals for cash, and the Milwaukee Brewers acquiring Lance McCullers Jr. and Colton Gordon from the Houston Astros in exchange for Jadyn Fielder.

top_news.title: **Rays Suffer Shutout Loss to Red Sox**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dominated the Tampa Bay Rays 10-0, handing them a decisive defeat. Carlos Narváez led the Red Sox offense with 3 hits, including a home run, while Jake Bennett earned the win with 6 strong innings of work.

top_news.title: **Rays Fall to Red Sox in 3-5 Showdown**
top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox secured a 3-5 victory over the Tampa Bay Rays, snapping their opponent's winning streak. Wilyer Abreu led the Rays' offense with 2 hits, including 2 home runs, and 3 RBIs.

top_news.title: **Dodgers Take Down Yankees in Thrilling 2-1 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Los Angeles Dodgers edged out the New York Yankees 2-1, securing their win behind a strong performance from their lineup. Max Muncy led the charge with a home run and 2 RBI.

top_news.title: **Braves Rout Rangers in Blowout Victory**
top_news.summary: The Atlanta Braves dominated the Texas Rangers 15-1, securing a decisive win. Chris Sale led the Braves' pitching effort, throwing 7.0 innings with 6 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Bassitt Shifted to 60-Day IL**
top_news.summary: Baltimore Orioles right-hander Chris Bassitt has been transferred from the 15-day injured list to the 60-day injured list due to low back discomfort. This move will keep Bassitt sidelined for at least the next 60 days.

top_news.title: **Martin Jr. Joins Orioles**
top_news.summary: Rudy Martin Jr. has been traded to the Baltimore Orioles from the Kansas City Royals in exchange for cash. The trade was finalized on July 18, 2026.
